description: Add navigation tab row to OperatorWindow with tab switching between Services, Songs, Scripture, Media panels, Tools dropdown, Settings opener, and AddServiceItem dialog wiring.
steps: Add Row 2 (Height 36) for navigation tabs between Header (Row 1) and Content (now Row 3)
Update existing content from Row 2 to Row 3, transport bar from Row 3 to Row 4
Add tab buttons: Services, Songs, Scripture, Media, Tools (dropdown), Settings gear
Add ContentPresenter/frames for Songs, Scripture, Media panels with Visibility toggling
Add code-behind tab switching logic, Tools dropdown ContextMenu, Settings/AddItem dialog opening
Handle errors gracefully when loading panels
acceptance_criteria: Tab bar visible between header and content area
Clicking Services shows slide grid, Songs shows SongLibraryPanel, Scripture shows ScriptureBrowserPanel, Media shows MediaLibraryPanel
Tools button shows dropdown with Alert, Countdown, Search, CCLI Report
findings: Build succeeds with 0 errors (only pre-existing CS0414 warning in MediaLibraryPanel). All 411 tests pass. DisplaySettings_Click was changed from opening DisplaySettingsWindow (which required engine/displayManager) to opening SettingsWindow directly. The ThemeSettings_Click handler remains as an unused placeholder in code-behind (harmless). Panels are lazy-loaded on first tab click to avoid startup cost. GlobalSearchPanel is a UserControl so it is wrapped in a Window for dialog display.
